chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.
For those who fear Him, and Allah loves the doers of good.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Allah's Word being described as perfect for the pious?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this hadith to anchor the concept of divine perfection in the moral attributes of Taqwa and Ihsan, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interplay between faith and righteous action. By citing specific Quranic verses, al-Saduq establishes that these qualities are not merely personal virtues but are divinely sanctioned, thereby validating the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt who embody these traits. This linkage serves to reinforce the theological principle that true piety leads to divine favor and closeness to God.
